def upper_bound(arr, target):
    low = 0                      # left edge of the unresolved search range
    high = len(arr)              # exclusive right edge; answer may equal len(arr)

    while low < high:            # keep searching until both boundaries meet
        mid = low + (high - low) // 2  # overflow-safe midpoint

        if arr[mid] <= target:   # equal values are not upper-bound candidates
            low = mid + 1        # discard this value and everything before it
        else:                    # arr[mid] is a valid candidate (> target)
            high = mid           # keep it and search left for an earlier candidate

    return low                   # first index whose value is strictly greater

steps.message: Start with low = 0 and high = 7. mid is 3 and arr[mid] is 20.
20 is equal to the target, so it is not strictly greater. Move low to mid + 1 = 4.
40 is strictly greater and could be the answer. Move high to mid = 5.
30 is also strictly greater. Move high to mid = 4.
